sentences.text: Changmaornis is a basal ornithuromorph dinosaur belonging to the parent group Ornithuromorpha within the class Reptilia.
Scientists have found only one recorded fossil occurrence of this animal so far.
Wang, O'Connor, Li, and You first described the genus in 2013, naming the type species Changmaornis houi.
Remains were discovered in the Xiagou Formation of the Changma Basin in Gansu Province, northwestern China.
Fossils date to the Early Cretaceous period, specifically between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
